$comment: The practice room: every kind of game element, nothing that can hurt a bot. Ingram asked for it on 2026-11-20. The bots are never told how the elements work: they find out by trying.
name: The Practice Room
description: A risk-free room with every kind of element in it, for the bots to discover before the first real level.
notes: What there is to discover. Door D1 (to the closet coin) opens while plate P1 has a bot on it OR while plate P2 is pressed; P2 needs 1.30, so one bot is too light: crate C2 pushed two tiles left onto it, or two bots stacked, will do. One bot alone cannot hold P1 and walk through D1. Door E1 (to the exit nook) opens while lever V1 is on (it flips) OR while lever V2 is held. C1 is light (any bot can push it); C2 weighs 1.40 and needs two pushers. The step is 1 tile high, the ledge 2, the platform top 2 above the floor; the pit is 1 tile deep.
